subject.title: fix: preserve prompt cache prefixes across room-event runs

question: Should ambient room_event turns use the non-owner owner-only core-tool inventory even when the sender is an owner, in order to keep prompt-cache prefixes stable?
rationale: This is an intentional owner-only tool inventory policy change: it appears safer than exposing blocked owner-only schemas, but it can change existing owner room_event capability and should not be decided only by automation.

options.title: Keep ambient-safe inventory
options.body: Ambient room_event turns omit cron, gateway, and nodes for both owner and non-owner senders, preserving cache stability without widening non-owner execution.

options.title: Preserve owner inventory
options.body: Owner-sent room_event turns keep owner-only core tools, accepting sender-dependent prompt/tool cache churn for compatibility.

options.title: Defer the policy change
options.body: Keep this PR draft or split the inventory decision from the prompt-mode propagation repair.

recommendation.title: Keep ambient-safe inventory
recommendation.body: Ambient room_event turns omit cron, gateway, and nodes for both owner and non-owner senders, preserving cache stability without widening non-owner execution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across room-event delivery policy, Codex app-server behavior, and owner/tool gating surfaces touched by this decision.
